note: Both sets read the two temperature charts, but Set A contains several clearly misread values (e.g., Avg. Mean 54 F and Avg. Low 40 F for January in Figure 1, Series 2 55 F in January, Series 3 43 F in February, Avg. Low 40 F in December) and even contradicts itself with two different January Avg. Low values (22 F and 40 F). Set A also adds six vague claims keyed only to 'Temperature Series 1/2/3 (Yellow/Red/Brown)' with property 'value' and no figure specified, which do not bind to a real component or property. Set B is closer to the plotted points overall (e.g., Louisville Avg. High 88 F in July, Avg. Mean 77 F in July, Irvine Avg. Mean 55 F in December, Avg. Low 40 F in December), though it also has a few misreads (Louisville red-line 56 F in February, yellow-line 67 F in March) and several 'Bowman Field | temperature' claims with an unspecified series and axis-label-only quotes. On balance Set B has fewer wrong and unsupported claims while keeping the month/series conditions.
